failedAssertion.message: Rapid edits canceled in-flight real template layer requests.

partialEvidence: real-28-recipes.json was written before the failure
Dots and Grok real View/Edit/export/original-download flow evidence and video segments were written before the failure
diagnosis: The assertion counted only aborts in a delayed fetch wrapper and removed its abort listener as soon as native fetch began. During rapid option changes, the renderer consumer was canceled but the shared option-thumbnail consumer correctly kept the same loader job alive. The assertion therefore missed consumer cancellation and did not separately exercise destroy-time cancellation of the final consumer.
